relations.rationale: Finishing order between Ivo and Kira has no bearing on how many parts their designs used.
Ivo finishing ahead of Kira suggests a performance difference, which weighs against the designs working equally well in trials.
Adjusting the robot's wheels after a collision aligns with wanting to improve balance for the next round.
Nell finishing ahead of Kira in a competition has no logical bearing on their relative ages.
Nell being younger than Leo says nothing about Nell's age relative to Kira.
Nell's age relative to Leo has no connection to Ivo's height relative to Nell.
Nell being younger than Leo is consistent with and supports Leo being the oldest participant.
Nell's age relative to Leo has no bearing on the number of parts in Kira's or Ivo's designs.
Nell being older than Kira has no connection to how easy Noor's robot was to spot.
Ivo being taller than Nell doesn't determine or affect Ivo's height relative to Noor.
Ivo's height compared to Nell has no bearing on Leo helping newer members solder wires.
A bright yellow robot would be visually distinctive, supporting the claim that it was easy to spot among others.
Using fewer parts doesn't necessarily prevent equal performance in trials, so this is not strongly related.
